value.rationale: The model natural invariant is which species pair completes stochastic sorting. Its sharp phase boundary, first-order cusp and probabilistic 1-to-1/2+1/2 transition are meaningful structural distinctions rather than isolated numerical parameter choices. The nonobvious open interval 1<r<r* shows the central cut remains the bottleneck even when its local rate gap exceeds both edge gaps. The statement resolves all positive central-gap ratios in the canonical symmetric four-class one-parameter family.
